summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a private placement of C$600 million 6.50% senior unsecured notes due 2033. The proceeds will fund a portion of the previously announced acquisition of Blue Canyon Technologies. The notes are priced at par, are senior unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing notes, and are guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. The offering is expected to close on August 5, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This filing reports a debt financing transaction in support of a pending acquisition; the financing itself is not a special situation event.
